messages.subject: Caspian / Stratton Energy – Master SaaS Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

Good to be working with you again. Please find attached our first draft of the Master Software-as-a-Service Agreement for the Caspian Climate Intelligence Platform, reflecting the heads of terms. The schedules (SOW, SLA and DPA) will follow separately but the key commercial terms are all in clause 6.

We'd be grateful for your mark-up at your client's convenience – we're working towards signature in May. Happy to take comments in tracked changes.

Kind regards,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

James,
